options.description: Launch to ten friendly mid-market accounts, then expand on evidence.
options.name: Phased rollout
options.trade_off: Slower revenue ramp; rivals may move first.
options.upside: Limits downside and generates proof before scale.
what_must_be_true: Ten friendly accounts agree to the pilot

options.description: Deliver the AI line through an integration partner.
options.name: Partner-led
options.trade_off: Margin share and less control of the experience.
